steps.title: Welcome to your workspace
steps.body: After signing in, open your dashboard. Training explains the system; it is not a required first task. Use the left menu to move between work areas.
steps.check: Find the main menu and the Account link.

steps.title: Organization and tenants
steps.body: An organization is the business you work in. PrimeCare uses a tenant to keep that organization’s records separate. A master tenant can group related tenants; it does not make their private records shared. Select the correct tenant before changing records.
steps.check: Check the tenant name before starting work.
domains: Organization / tenant: business identity and its own records
Locations / territories: where the business operates
Users and roles: who works here and what each person can access

steps.title: People and access
steps.body: Accounts are sign-in identities. A role controls permitted tasks. A client receives services; a provider or staff member delivers or supports them. These are different responsibilities.
steps.check: Identify your own role. Ask your administrator if an expected menu is missing.
domains: Staff and providers: people delivering and supporting care
Administrators: people managing the organization and access

steps.title: Services and daily work
steps.body: Services describe what the organization offers. Appointments or visits connect a client, an eligible provider, a service and a time. Only available, authorized screens can save changes.
steps.check: Open an available work area from your menu; review its instructions before saving.
domains: Care plans, visits and service notes

steps.title: Calls, messages and account phone
steps.body: Account phone verification links a mobile number to your account. Enter the SMS code in the account screen. Call verification is a separate step for a particular connected call. Do not speak codes to the AI.
steps.check: Open Account and check your phone status. Open Calls only if your role offers it.
domains: SMS, email and other configured channels

steps.title: Billing, reports and audit
steps.body: Billing, reporting and audit are separate work areas. A dashboard total is a summary, not proof that a payment or service is complete. Review saved records and permissions. Some domains may not yet be enabled for your role.
steps.check: Locate Reports or Audit if they appear in your menu.
domains: Invoices, payments and reconciliation where enabled

steps.title: Your first-day checklist
steps.body: Start with these small tasks: open your dashboard, confirm your organization, review your role, verify your phone if needed, and find the one work area you need today. You can return to this guide at any time.
steps.check: Use Open dashboard to continue. Detailed lessons remain available below the guide.
